decisions.reason: The accelerator draws on the firm's advisory capabilities and partner network rather than its core engineering knowledge, so it is only loosely related, but it is cheap to run and still featured on the home page.

The bio-based bitumen binder sits farthest from the firm's machinery and waste-treatment expertise, which makes its results hard to interpret and improve, yet its continued dedicated page and fit with the firm's in-house R&D suggest it stays one more year.

The infectious waste decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's modular recycling technology and is reinforced by the ERMAFA cooperation, giving strong absorptive capacity to refine it, and it is promoted prominently.
